001package com.fs.starfarer.api.plugins.impl;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FactionAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.GenericPluginManagerAPI.GenericPlugin;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Entities;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.plugins.BuildObjectiveTypePicker;
011
012public class CoreBuildObjectiveTypePicker implements BuildObjectiveTypePicker, GenericPlugin {
013
014        public String pickObjectiveToBuild(BuildObjectiveParams params) {
015                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = params.fleet;
016                FactionAPI faction = params.faction;
017                SectorEntityToken stableLoc = params.stableLoc;
018                
019                boolean hasComm = false;
020                boolean hasSensor = false;
021                boolean hasNav = false;
022                for (SectorEntityToken curr : stableLoc.getContainingLocation().getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.OBJECTIVE)) {
023                        // don't own this, and not hostile, so won't be retaking either - ok to build duplicate
024                        if (curr.getFaction() != faction && !curr.getFaction().isHostileTo(faction)) {
025                                continue;
026                        }
027                        hasComm |= curr.hasTag(Tags.COMM_RELAY);
028                        hasSensor |= curr.hasTag(Tags.SENSOR_ARRAY);
029                        hasNav |= curr.hasTag(Tags.NAV_BUOY);
030                }
031                
032                if (faction.getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_PIRATE_BEHAVIOR)) {
033                        if (!hasSensor && !hasNav) {
034                                if ((float) Math.random() > 0.5f) {
035                                        return Entities.NAV_BUOY_MAKESHIFT;
036                                }
037                                return Entities.SENSOR_ARRAY_MAKESHIFT;
038                        }
039                        if (!hasSensor) {
040                                return Entities.SENSOR_ARRAY_MAKESHIFT;
041                        }
042                        if (!hasNav) {
043                                return Entities.NAV_BUOY_MAKESHIFT;
044                        }
045                        if (!hasComm) {
046                                return Entities.COMM_RELAY_MAKESHIFT;
047                        }
048                } else {
049                        if (!hasComm) {
050                                return Entities.COMM_RELAY_MAKESHIFT;
051                        }
052                        if (!hasNav) {
053                                return Entities.NAV_BUOY_MAKESHIFT;
054                        }
055                        if (!hasSensor) {
056                                return Entities.SENSOR_ARRAY_MAKESHIFT;
057                        }
058                }
059                return null;
060        }
061
062        
063        
064        public int getHandlingPriority(Object params) {
065                if (params instanceof BuildObjectiveParams) {
066                        return 0;
067                }
068                return -1;
069        }
070
071}
